environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'payments' with Kubernetes service type LoadBalancer exposing port 8080 directly. Pod runs with default service account. Envoy sidecar configured as gRPC-Web transcoder only (no auth filter). Ingress has no additional middleware. Session cookies are set with Secure flag but no SameSite attribute. CORS is permissive (reflects Origin header). No Istio AuthorizationPolicy applied.
